name: 35901 · Gadsden, AL
findings: ZIP 35901 (Gadsden) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35901 (Gadsden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 35901 (Gadsden) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
